title: neonauclea synkorynes
intro: Neonauclea synkorynes, commonly known as the Philippine yellow senna, is a plant species native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Neonauclea synkorynes include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
